echo '## Disk usage:'

echo '
## Potential notes files:'
ls -lah /root 2>/dev/null || true
ls -lah /var/tmp 2>/dev/null || true
ls -lah /var/lib 2>/dev/null | head -n 50 || true
ls -lah /var/log 2>/dev/null | head -n 200 || true

( find /root /etc /var /opt -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname "*notes*" -o -iname "*shift*" -o -iname "*handoff*" \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 50 ) || true

printf '\n## Check logrotate config for agent-platform:\n'
ls -l /etc/logrotate.d 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,200p'

printf '\n## Show /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf if present:\n'
[ -f /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf ] && { echo '--- BEGIN /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf ---'; sed -n '1,200p' /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf; echo '--- END ---'; } || echo 'agent-platform.conf not found'

printf '\n## Check logrotate status file:\n'
[ -f /var/lib/logrotate/status ] && { echo '--- BEGIN /var/lib/logrotate/status ---'; tail -n +1 /var/lib/logrotate/status; echo '--- END ---'; } || echo 'logrotate status file not found'

printf '\n## Locate agent-platform log directories:\n'
( ls -lah /var/log/agent-platform 2>/dev/null || true )
( ls -lah /srv/log/agent-platform 2>/dev/null || true )
( ls -lah /var/log | grep -i agent 2>/dev/null || true )

  else
    echo 'sudo present but no passwordless sudo; attempting without sudo...'
    logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf || true

  logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf || true
fi

TMP_LIST=$(mktemp)
find "$LOG_DIR" "$AUDIT_DIR" -type f -mtime +30 \
  \( -name '*.log' -o -name '*.log.*' -o -name '*.gz' \) \
  -not -name 'HANDOFF.txt' \
  -print0 > "$TMP_LIST"

# Calculate total bytes and count to be removed
REMOVE_COUNT=0
REMOVE_BYTES=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  sz=$(stat -c '%s' "$f" || echo 0)
  REMOVE_BYTES=$((REMOVE_BYTES + sz))
  REMOVE_COUNT=$((REMOVE_COUNT + 1))
Done=true

done < "$TMP_LIST"

# Compress uncompressed .log files older than 7 days (excluding active base logs)

find "$LOG_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +7 \

  xargs -0 rm -f < "$TMP_LIST"

# List resulting directory for verification
ls -lah "$LOG_DIR" | sed -n '1,200p'
ls -lah "$AUDIT_DIR" | sed -n '1,200p'
", "set -euo pipefail
LOG_DIR=/var/log/agent-platform
AUDIT_DIR=/var/log/agent-platform/audit

# Parse previous summary if present
PREV_COUNT=0
PREV_MB=0.0
if [ -f "$LOG_DIR/PRUNE_SUMMARY.txt" ]; then
  line=$(tail -n 1 "$LOG_DIR/PRUNE_SUMMARY.txt" || true)
  # Extract numbers: e.g., "Removed 4 agent-platform log files older than 30 days totaling 31.8MB"
  if printf '%s' "$line" | grep -q 'Removed'; then
    PREV_COUNT=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed -n 's/.*Removed \([0-9]\+\).*/\1/p')
    PREV_MB=$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed -n 's/.*totaling \([0-9.]\+\)MB.*/\1/p')
  fi
fi

# Build list of files >30 days now
TMP_LIST=$(mktemp)
find "$LOG_DIR" "$AUDIT_DIR" -type f -mtime +30 \
  -not -name 'HANDOFF.txt' -not -name 'PRUNE_SUMMARY.txt' \
  -print0 > "$TMP_LIST"

# Calculate total bytes and count to be removed in this pass
CUR_COUNT=0
CUR_BYTES=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  sz=$(stat -c '%s' "$f" || echo 0)
  CUR_BYTES=$((CUR_BYTES + sz))
  CUR_COUNT=$((CUR_COUNT + 1))
Done=true

done < "$TMP_LIST"

# Remove them
if [ -s "$TMP_LIST" ]; then
  xargs -0 rm -f < "$TMP_LIST"
fi
rm -f "$TMP_LIST"

# Totals combined
TOTAL_COUNT=$(( (PREV_COUNT>0?PREV_COUNT:0) + CUR_COUNT ))
# Sum MB precisely using awk
TOTAL_MB=$(awk -v a="${PREV_MB:-0}" -v b_bytes="$CUR_BYTES" 'BEGIN { b=b_bytes/1024/1024; printf "%.1f", a + b }')

DATE=$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ')
SUMMARY_LINE="$DATE: Removed $TOTAL_COUNT agent-platform log files older than 30 days totaling ${TOTAL_MB}MB"

# Overwrite PRUNE_SUMMARY.txt with the single summary line
printf '%s\n' "$SUMMARY_LINE" > "$LOG_DIR/PRUNE_SUMMARY.txt"

# Show disk usage and directory listing
printf 'Disk usage after second-pass prune:\n'
df -h /
ls -lah "$LOG_DIR" | sed -n '1,200p'
ls -lah "$AUDIT_DIR" | sed -n '1,200p'
", "set -euo pipefail

printf '\n## logrotate status after forced run:\n'

# List files again to see if any new rotations occurred
ls -lah /var/log/agent-platform | sed -n '1,200p'
ls -lah /var/log/agent-platform/audit | sed -n '1,200p'"]
